items.exampleEn: Few people understood the significance of his discovery.

items.exampleEn: Flying like a bird is a childhood fantasy of mine.

items.exampleEn: My brother and I differ in many ways.

items.exampleEn: Please tell us your preference: tea or coffee?

items.exampleEn: My phone has a tendency to get hot when I play games.
items.exampleZh: 我的手機一玩遊戲就有發燙的傾向。

items.sentenceEn: Our tastes in music differ a lot.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的音樂品味非常不同。

items.audioEn: My sister has a preference for window seats, so I booked one for her.
items.audioZh: 我的姊妹比較喜歡靠窗的座位，所以我幫她訂了一個。
items.questionZh: 說話者幫自己的姊妹訂了什麼座位？
options: A window seat for the speaker
A seat in the middle row
A seat next to her friend

items.sentenceEn: There is a tendency for prices to rise in summer.
items.sentenceZh: 夏天物價有上漲的趨勢。

items.sentenceEn: After the demonstration, everyone tried it themselves.
items.sentenceZh: 示範之後，每個人都自己試了一次。

items.stemEn: The science teacher did a ____ to show how plants drink water.
items.stemZh: 自然老師做了一個示範，說明植物怎麼吸水。

items.stemEn: The new movie is very ____: half the people love it, and half hate it.
items.stemZh: 這部新電影很有爭議：一半的人喜歡，一半的人討厭。

items.passageEn: Every Friday is movie night in my family, but we never agree on a movie. My little brother has a strong preference for fantasy, because it helps him relax. For instance, he has watched one fantasy film five times! My dad has a tendency to fall asleep during long movies, so he always wants something short. Last Friday, my brother showed us the first five minutes of his favorite fantasy film. Everyone liked it, so we watched the whole film together. Afterward, my dad explained the significance of movie night: it doesn't matter what we watch, as long as we are together.
items.passageZh: 每週五是我們家的電影之夜，但我們從來沒辦法選定同一部電影。我弟弟特別偏好奇幻片，因為能幫助他放鬆。例如，有一部奇幻片他已經看了五次！我爸爸有看長片就睡著的傾向，所以他總是想看短一點的。上週五，弟弟放了他最愛的奇幻片的前五分鐘給我們看。大家都很喜歡，所以我們一起把整部片看完。看完後，爸爸說明了電影之夜的意義：看什麼不重要，重要的是我們在一起。

questions.questionZh: 弟弟為什麼喜歡奇幻片？
options: 因為奇幻片通常都很短
因為奇幻片能幫助他放鬆

questions.questionZh: 上週五他們最後怎麼做？
options: 改看媽媽想看的老電影
一起看完弟弟最愛的奇幻片

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："Last week, our class had a discussion about a controversial question: should our school library buy more fantasy books? Opinions differed a lot. Some students had a strong preference for fantasy because it helps them relax. For instance, Mia said fantasy stories help her forget her stress. Others said students have a tendency to read only fantasy and ignore other books. Our teacher stayed neutral and explained the significance of reading many kinds of books. Then she gave a short demonstration: she read a page from a fantasy book and a page from a history book, and asked us to compare them. In the end, we voted, and the library will buy more of both."；改後："Every Friday is movie night in my family, but we never agree on a movie. My little brother has a strong preference for fantasy, because it helps him relax. For instance, he has watched one fantasy film five times! My dad has a tendency to fall asleep during long movies, so he always wants something short. Last Friday, my brother gave a short demonstration: he showed us the first five minutes of his favorite fantasy film. Everyone liked it, so we watched the whole film together. Afterward, my dad explained the significance of movie night: it doesn't matter what we watch, as long as we are together."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："上週，我們班討論了一個有爭議的問題：學校圖書館該不該買更多奇幻小說？大家的意見非常不同。有些同學特別偏好奇幻小說，因為能幫助他們放鬆。例如，Mia 說奇幻故事能幫她忘掉壓力。其他人則說，學生有偏讀奇幻小說、忽略其他書的傾向。老師保持中立，並說明了閱讀各類書籍的重要性。接著她做了一個簡短的示範：她讀了一頁奇幻小說和一頁歷史書，要我們比較兩者。最後我們投票，圖書館兩種書都會多買一些。"；改後："每週五是我們家的電影之夜，但我們從來沒辦法選定同一部電影。我弟弟特別偏好奇幻片，因為能幫助他放鬆。例如，有一部奇幻片他已經看了五次！我爸爸有看長片就睡著的傾向，所以他總是想看短一點的。上週五，弟弟做了一個簡短的示範：他放了他最愛的奇幻片的前五分鐘給我們看。大家都很喜歡，所以我們一起把整部片看完。看完後，爸爸說明了電影之夜的意義：看什麼不重要，重要的是我們在一起。"
